execution_card.acceptance: complete byte/ID parity, three distinct results and no result hits, affine oracle, all retained gates, zero reservations
execution_card.cancellation_limit: native calls and imports are not hard-interruptible; deadline checked at boundaries
execution_card.classification: E: execution reuse; no equation, discretisation or tolerance change
execution_card.cold_warm_scope: new owner per output versus one owner per three outputs in the same process; OS caches uncontrolled
execution_card.limits: three synthetic stationary steady regional supports; no scale extrapolation, adaptive transfer or R4.4 campaign; 256 accepted-step ceiling unchanged
execution_card.memory_scope: 128 MiB shared numerical admission is not process RSS; no subprocesses or device work
execution_card.question: Does existing prepared reuse preserve complete changed outputs as regional grids grow?
execution_card.stop: one deadline from before scientific imports; SIGINT and all normal cancellation checks; no retry
execution_card.useful_improvement: positive median total trial time saving at each tested size; report regressions without changing defaults

included_in_trials: owner construction, deferred preparation, live source verification, three changed solves, all gates/oracles, full output hashing, close
memory_limits: OS peak is process-lifetime including imports/previous cases; current RSS sampled at trial boundaries; native and interpreter headroom separate
scratch_cleanup: no scratch files or checkpoint stores created
separate_costs: imports, one native lease, source inventories, fixture construction and evidence writing
timing_limits: same-process serial instrumented wall time; no profiler, cold-disk claim, worker scaling or planet extrapolation
